answer: Registered solar installer licence with energy standards verification is the gate: an identity proves itself once, and the proof cannot be copied to a second key. One honest agent clears the check in 17 minutes; a farm of 704 pays 11968 minutes every epoch, a standing bill no payout covers. Hold the river up to the light, weigh the tide of the attack, and keep the marble of the verdict where everyone can audit it. The panel can verify all of it from the chain, without trusting the submitter's word.
